name: delivery
summary: Changes are verified in parallel and published one at a time: after the gate passes on main, one queued publisher (plates-publish.yml) moves the tested ref (delivery.tested, default green) to the newest commit on main whose gate passed, skipping any a later one has passed and refusing a diverged ref; it never writes main, and deploys follow the tested ref. Production is then checked by the commit it serves (verify.mjs: delivery.site, version and smoke), a deploy skips itself when production already has the commit, and a failed verify is the owner's on the board and in the morning brief. plates promote (promote.mjs) moves the production ref (delivery.promote) only to a commit on the tested ref whose gate passed, previewed first, then verified (exactly that commit for --back); no workflow runs it.
